serverInfo.name: hypernatt-terminal
serverInfo.title: HyperNatt Terminal - Liq Radar + Swap for AI Agents
serverInfo.description:
HyperNatt Terminal - agent MCP: forced-order / liquidation map + Li.Fi swap. get_liq_radar whitelist BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP HYPE ZEC (omit = BTC). Market structure classic public indicators do not show. Read-only context, not trade advice. No custody.

Platform: https://hypernatt.com - this MCP is one agent-facing brick.
Security: no custody, no keys, x402 you control, public code (SECURITY.md).
3 tools / v2.7.0 / Streamable HTTP. Call get_agent_manifest first.

LIQ RADAR: get_liq_radar (optional symbol). SWAP: your hot wallet as fromAddress. x402 USDC pays API only.
Pricing: free get_agent_manifest; get_liq_radar $0.001/call x402 (Base + Solana). Swap free at MCP (you sign).

No wallet? npx @coinbase/payments-mcp then connect Terminal (docs.cdp.coinbase.com/agentic-wallet/mcp/welcome).

Docs: github.com/DIALLOUBE-RESEARCH/hypernatt-terminal

ecosystem.note: Discover the full HyperNatt product on the homepage; use this server card for the agent terminal only. Vault/platform track record is NOT this MCP's P&L.

privacy_note: Tool usage (wallet address, tool name, timestamp, market context) is logged to improve HyperNatt Terminal. No prompt content. No resale.

pass_program.note: Default: pay-per-call $0.001 via x402. Optional Agent Pass $5/mo (~15,000 credits) for heavy use — not required.

quota_program.note: Optional bonus credits from swap volume. Status: GET /api/m2m/quota/status · balance: GET /api/m2m/quota/balance?wallet=0x…

tools.name: get_agent_manifest
tools.description: Start here (free): catalog of 3 terminal tools + value_proposition_v1 + use_scenarios_v1 + glossary_v1 under agent_interpretation_rules_v1. Then call get_liq_radar for the forced-order map.

tools.name: get_liq_radar
tools.description: Forced-order / liquidation map — magnet bias, OI build-up, L/S ratio, clusters above/below, real liqs 1h/24h. Whitelist BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP HYPE ZEC (omit symbol = BTC). Market structure classic public indicators do not show. USE WHEN: terrain / timing / sizing context. NOT a trade signal or Fuel Score. RETURNS: hypernatt_liq_radar_v2. COST: $0.001 x402 (Base or Solana). Side effects: none.

agent_wallet.description: EVM wallet 0x… — quota bypass when balance covers tool weight.

symbol.description: Optional crypto symbol (BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP HYPE ZEC). Default BTC when omitted.

tools.name: swap_via_nattswap
tools.description: Cross-chain token swap powered by Li.Fi across 70+ chains incl. Hyperliquid. USE WHEN: bridge, fund gas, treasury routing, or rebalance. RETURNS: Li.Fi route + execution_readiness + swap_actions_v1 + recommended_action. Prefer signing swap_actions_v1 in order. MCP free; on-chain swap costs gas + integrator fee. Side effects: MCP read-only until wallet signs.
